page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 96 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, this instance features 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing a dedicated CPU allocation. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for integer and bfloat16 operations. Local storage is provided via a 5669 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities and exceptional memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier status in Passmark CPU tests, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics simulations. Large-block memory bandwidth benchmarks for both read and write operations rank in the top 10% of tested hardware, reflecting high resource density. While single-core performance in stress-ng and compression tasks falls within the average range, multi-threaded operations, such as bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput, demonstrate strong to top-tier execution.

With 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU and a large local NVMe SSD, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and large-scale data processing. Passmark database operations and Redis SET benchmarks show strong performance, making it suitable for relational databases and in-memory caches. For machine learning workloads, the hardware supports AVX and AMX instructions, yielding strong prompt processing and text generation speeds for medium-sized 7B LLM models, though performance drops to average levels when executing text generation on larger 70B models.
